main_text.p: ἀγυλος abscessus inter nares & majorem angulum oculorum.
ἀμπελάμπελος, vel ἀμπελίαμπελος, (per syncopen poet.) vitis agrestis, labrusca.
ἀπλατος, sive ἀπλατὸς, callis, semita trita.
ἵππος equitatus, vel equa: pro equo vero est masculinum.
ὄαφος uxor: pro confabulatione masculinum est.

page.notes: Greek words are transcribed as best legible from a soft, faded scan; accents and breathings are approximate. Several Greek lines are uncertain, notably the first word of each entry.
